entries.descriptionEn: Kimi Code CLI is Moonshot AI’s terminal coding agent, using Kimi models to read and edit code and use tools.

entries.bodyZh:
## 是什么
Kimi Code CLI 是面向开发者的终端 Agent，由 Moonshot AI 维护，直接支持 Kimi 模型，可在项目目录中读取与修改代码并使用工具。

## 快速使用
1. 按[上游安装指南](https://moonshotai.github.io/kimi-code/en/guides/getting-started)安装。
2. 进入项目目录，运行 `kimi`。
3. 通过 `/login` 选择上游文档支持的认证方式，再询问项目内容。

## 前提与限制
Windows 需要 Git for Windows。审核工具操作，把凭据保留在本机。本条目仅核对文档，未安装或实测软件。

## 出处

[上游 README](https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-code/blob/419aced0e97fa04b75f8f71b089e1667f6de6d0a/README.md)，核对版本 `419aced0e97fa04b75f8f71b089e1667f6de6d0a`。
entries.bodyEn:
## What it is
Kimi Code CLI is a terminal agent for developers working in a project directory. Moonshot AI maintains it, and Kimi models are supported directly.

## Quick start
1. Follow the [upstream installation guide](https://moonshotai.github.io/kimi-code/en/guides/getting-started).
2. Open a project directory and run `kimi`.
3. Use `/login` to choose the authentication method documented upstream, then ask about the project.

## Requirements and limits
Windows users need Git for Windows as documented upstream. Review requested tool actions and keep credentials local. This entry was checked against documentation; the software was not installed or tested here.

## Source

[Upstream README](https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-code/blob/419aced0e97fa04b75f8f71b089e1667f6de6d0a/README.md), checked revision `419aced0e97fa04b75f8f71b089e1667f6de6d0a`.

entries.bodyZh:
## 是什么
Kimi K3 是 Moonshot AI 发布的开放权重多模态模型，适合接入 Kimi 或评估模型部署的开发者。官方仓库提供技术报告与使用资料。

## 快速使用
1. 打开官方仓库的模型使用部分。
2. 选择其中说明的托管 API 或自托管方式。
3. 按对应文档完成认证、环境配置与模型调用。

## 前提与限制
托管调用需要所选供应商的访问权限；自托管需要上游指定的硬件与软件。部署前阅读模型许可证。本条目仅核对文档，不代表运行验证。

## 出处

[上游 README](https://github.com/MoonshotAI/Kimi-K3/blob/3cb39dfd32e51c3328e2e4b4af21341247d06c43/README.md)，核对版本 `3cb39dfd32e51c3328e2e4b4af21341247d06c43`。
entries.bodyEn:
## What it is
Kimi K3 is an open-weight model from Moonshot AI for developers integrating Kimi or evaluating model deployment. The repository provides the model report and usage documentation.

## Quick start
1. Open the official repository and its model usage section.
2. Choose the documented hosted API or self-hosting route.
3. Follow that route’s authentication, environment and model instructions.

## Requirements and limits
Hosted use requires the selected provider’s access; self-hosting requires the hardware and software specified upstream. Check the model license before deployment. This entry verifies documentation, not runtime results.

## Source

[Upstream README](https://github.com/MoonshotAI/Kimi-K3/blob/3cb39dfd32e51c3328e2e4b4af21341247d06c43/README.md), checked revision `3cb39dfd32e51c3328e2e4b4af21341247d06c43`.

entries.bodyZh:
## 是什么
wjt0321 维护的社区 Windows 客户端，通过本机已安装的 Kimi Code CLI 提供窗口操作。它与 Yann-Up 的同名仓库是不同项目。

## 快速使用
1. 阅读上游 Windows 安装及 CLI 兼容说明。
2. 获取仓库指向的桌面发布版本。
3. 按说明检测本地 CLI 并启动服务。

## 前提与限制
使用上游发布版本支持的 CLI；认证由本地 CLI 处理。本条目仅核对 README，未安装或实测软件。

## 出处

[上游 README](https://github.com/wjt0321/kimi-code-desktop/blob/00f41ee1578f2e03e2192557c8b4bb9f84b9c2ee/README.md)，核对版本 `00f41ee1578f2e03e2192557c8b4bb9f84b9c2ee`。
entries.bodyEn:
## What it is
wjt0321 maintains a community Windows client for Kimi Code CLI. It uses the installed local CLI and is distinct from Yann-Up’s repository with the same project name.

## Quick start
1. Read the upstream Windows installation and CLI compatibility notes.
2. Get the desktop release linked by the repository.
3. Follow its local CLI detection and startup instructions.

## Requirements and limits
Use a CLI version supported by the upstream release. Authentication belongs to the local CLI. This entry was checked against the README; installation and behavior were not tested here.

## Source

[Upstream README](https://github.com/wjt0321/kimi-code-desktop/blob/00f41ee1578f2e03e2192557c8b4bb9f84b9c2ee/README.md), checked revision `00f41ee1578f2e03e2192557c8b4bb9f84b9c2ee`.

entries.bodyZh:
## 是什么
Yann-Up 维护的社区桌面客户端，适合偏好窗口操作的 Kimi Code 用户。它嵌入本地 Kimi Code CLI 的 Web 界面，与 CLI 是独立项目。

## 快速使用
1. 阅读上游平台与安装说明。
2. 在仓库 Releases 页面选择支持的平台版本。
3. 按首次启动说明配置 CLI 并完成认证。

## 前提与限制
应用依赖本地 CLI 及版本兼容性，升级前检查发布说明。本条目核对了文档，未安装或实测桌面软件。

## 出处

[上游 README](https://github.com/Yann-Up/kimi-code-desktop/blob/fd66c5c88e66b70becae2077a6a75ab318af1a51/README.md)，核对版本 `fd66c5c88e66b70becae2077a6a75ab318af1a51`。
entries.bodyEn:
## What it is
Yann-Up maintains this community desktop client for people who prefer a window to a terminal. It embeds the local Kimi Code CLI web interface; it is a separate project from the CLI.

## Quick start
1. Read the upstream platform and installation notes.
2. Obtain a release for a supported platform from the repository’s Releases page.
3. Follow the first-launch CLI setup and authentication instructions.

## Requirements and limits
The application depends on the local CLI and its compatibility. Check release notes before upgrading. Documentation was reviewed; desktop installation was not tested here.

## Source

[Upstream README](https://github.com/Yann-Up/kimi-code-desktop/blob/fd66c5c88e66b70becae2077a6a75ab318af1a51/README.md), checked revision `fd66c5c88e66b70becae2077a6a75ab318af1a51`.
